props.content: Prose, lists, records and media in one reading measure.

## Why foundation is small

Foundation ships the blocks every app needs and nothing a single kind of app needs. A pricing table, a product gallery or a map belongs to the pack whose subject it is.

That keeps the ground floor **light**, **testable on its own**, and the same in every runtime that implements the spec.

items: Every block is placed on a page in this pack
Two reference themes, one light and one dark
No call to an outside service
